channel.title: RealHunt: new homes
channel.description: New homes on RealHunt, checked by a person and scored from 70 to 98.

item.title: €54,029 · Move-in ready 4-bedroom house with garage and land in Belleterre, Témiscamingue, Quebec
item.description: Belleterre, Témiscamingue, Quebec. 174 m². RealHunt score 93. This move-in ready house in the village of Belleterre is ready for new owners to move in now. It has 4 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, with 174 m2 of living space. A garage and a parking space in the garage are included, and the property sits on a plot of land. The garage sits on a concrete slab and the home is available now. Asking €54,029, about €311/m².

item.title: €127,654 · Renovated 3-bedroom house with open plan kitchen and land in Saint-Fabien, Quebec
item.description: Saint-Fabien, Quebec. 163 m². RealHunt score 87. This renovated house has had several recent renovations, including the kitchen and ground-floor flooring. It offers 163 m2 of living area over 6 rooms, with 3 bedrooms, 1 bathroom and an open plan equipped kitchen. The plot covers 5,296 sq ft of land, and the home has air conditioning. A new central heat pump provides heating, and the home includes a central vacuum, a refrigerator, a dishwasher, a stove and a washer and dryer. Asking €127,654, about €783/m².

item.title: €105,455 · Move-in ready 3-bedroom house with pool and valley views in Limache, Valparaíso Region
item.description: Limache, Valparaíso Region. 126 m². RealHunt score 89. Move-in ready house of 126 m2 with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, including an en-suite main bedroom. It has a living room, separate dining room, kitchen, utility room and storage room, plus a cellar. Outside, the 5,000 m2 plot offers a swimming pool, a quincho with a clay oven and valley views. Covered parking for 2 vehicles and extra space for more. Electricity is connected and there is a wood stove, with Viña del Mar 30 minutes away. Asking €105,455, about €837/m².

item.title: €50,000 · Move-in ready 2-bedroom house with garden and land in Debeljaca, South Banat
item.description: Debeljaca, South Banat. 73 m². RealHunt score 89. This move-in ready home is a single-storey house with 73 m² of living space. It has a living room, two bedrooms, one bathroom, a hallway and an entrance hall, and the rooms are functional. The house is sold partially furnished. The property includes a garden and a plot of 3.64 acres, giving plenty of space for outdoor time and gardening. It is in order and ready to move into immediately. Asking €50,000, about €685/m².

item.title: €106,798 · Fully renovated 3-bedroom house with pool and garden in Burzaco, Buenos Aires Province
item.description: Burzaco, Buenos Aires Province. 106 m². RealHunt score 88. Fully renovated house in Burzaco with 3 bedrooms and 106 m2 of living area. The home has a living room, a wooden mezzanine and a spacious kitchen-diner. Two bedrooms, a full bathroom and an enclosed winter garden with its own full bathroom complete the layout. Outside there is a front garden, a patio and an open rear garden with a built-in swimming pool. There is also a driveway with a sliding gate and 3,821 sq ft of land. Asking €106,798, about €1,008/m².

item.title: €95,509 · Terraced 2-bedroom family house with covered yard in Bishop Auckland, County Durham
item.description: Bishop Auckland, County Durham. 90 m². RealHunt score 86. This terraced family home in Bishop Auckland is offered for sale with no onward chain. The ground floor offers an entrance hallway, a spacious living room, a dining room and a kitchen, and the first floor has two bedrooms and a bathroom. Externally there is an enclosed covered yard with a garage door leading to the rear lane, which could be used as secure car parking. Shops, supermarkets and schools are a short distance away, and public transport links to Darlington, Durham and Newcastle. Asking €95,509, about €1,061/m².

item.title: €150,535 · Move-in ready remodeled house with fireplace and wraparound porch in Cleveland, Ohio
item.description: Cleveland, Ohio. 255 m². RealHunt score 95. This move-in ready house has been remodeled and updated throughout. It offers 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, plus a separate living room, a family room, a dining area and a new oversized kitchen. Outside, there is a wraparound front porch, off-street parking and 4,865 sq ft of land. Extra features include a fireplace in the family room and a full cellar. Heating comes from a high-efficiency furnace and hot water tank installed in 2023. Asking €150,535, about €590/m².

item.title: €179,000 · Move-in ready 3-bedroom semi-detached villa with pool and views in Alanya, Antalya
item.description: Alanya, Antalya. 150 m². RealHunt score 87. This move-in ready semi-detached villa was built in 2006 and spans three floors. It has 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, and white goods and furniture are included. Outdoor features include a garden, a spacious terrace, a big balcony, a pool with a children's pool, and views of the castle, city and sea. The property has open car parking, bicycle parking, camera surveillance and concierge service. It is 5 km from the city centre and beaches, and 140 metres from the airport. Asking €179,000, about €1,193/m².

item.title: €95,509 · 2-bedroom terraced house in good condition with rear yard in Hunwick, County Durham
item.description: Hunwick, County Durham, North East England. 80 m². RealHunt score 86. This modern terraced house is in good condition and offered with no onward chain. The ground floor has an entrance hall leading into an open plan living room, dining room and kitchen, and the first floor has two double bedrooms and a family bathroom. Outside there is on-street parking to the front and an enclosed rear yard with gated access to the back lane. The village has a primary school, village hall, church, pub, tea room and a local shop, with frequent buses to Durham, Darlington and Newcastle. Asking €95,509, about €1,194/m².

item.title: €49,707 · Well maintained semi-detached house with garden and fireplace in Rumia, Pomerania
item.description: Rumia, Pomerania. 100 m². RealHunt score 93. This well maintained semi-detached house, built in 2009, is in Janowo, Rumia. The ground floor has a living room, separate kitchen and WC, and the first floor has two bedrooms with balconies and a bathroom with bath and shower. Outdoor and extra features include a garden of about 161 m², a fireplace in the living room, two courtyard parking spaces and CCTV. The home has gas heating and a new Viessmann boiler fitted two years ago, and it is a 5-minute walk from Rumia Janowo SKM station. Asking €49,707, about €497/m².

item.title: €164,607 · House in good condition with wood stove and beach nearby in Cerros de los Rochas, Rocha
item.description: Cerros de los Rochas, Rocha. 301 m². RealHunt score 88. This property is in good condition and comprises two houses and a cabin on one 510 m² plot. Each front house has a wood-burning stove in the living-dining room, three bedrooms (one on the ground floor), a bathroom and a separate kitchen. The cabin has a living-dining room with an integrated kitchen, a bathroom and two upstairs bedrooms, and sleeps four. The plot has 17 m of frontage on the main road, the beach is a few blocks away, and there is a bus stop at the door. Asking €164,607, about €547/m².

item.title: €197,000 · In good condition 3-bedroom house with garden views in Archaio Limani, Corinthia, Peloponnese
item.description: Archaio Limani, Corinthia, Peloponnese. 160 m². RealHunt score 86. This detached house is in good condition and spread over two levels, ground floor and first floor. It has 3 bedrooms, a spacious living and dining area with a fireplace, and 2 bathrooms. A 1,000 sq m plot holds a large garden with olive and fruit trees, and large verandas offer panoramic views. Parking is available for 2 vehicles, and oil-fired central heating is fitted. The beach is a 5-minute drive away, and public transport is close by. Asking €197,000, about €1,231/m².

item.title: €93,425 · 2-bedroom cabin and studio with garden near the beach in Piedras de Afilar, Canelones
item.description: Piedras de Afilar, Canelones. 173 m². RealHunt score 92. This property is a cabin and studio on a 495 m² plot in Piedras de Afilar, Canelones. The cabin has an open-plan living area and a mezzanine bedroom, and the listing shows 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom across 173 m² built. The grounds include a spacious garden with plenty of shade, a terrace, a covered barbecue area with grill and a storage room. The studio apartment has a wood-burning stove, and the beach is 800 m away. Asking €93,425, about €540/m².

item.title: €132,023 · Move-in ready 3-bedroom villa with private pool and office in Guayaquil, Guayas
item.description: Guayaquil, Guayas. 160 m². RealHunt score 89. This move-in ready villa is a modern home in a gated community. It has 3 bedrooms, each with its own closet and en-suite bathroom, 4 bathrooms in total, spacious living and dining rooms, a functional kitchen and a separate space for an office or study. Outdoor features include a private swimming pool and a private outdoor entertaining area, on 1,722 sq ft of land. The complex has 24/7 security and a gated entrance for a peaceful environment. Asking €132,023, about €825/m².

item.title: €185,000 · Move-in ready furnished 3-bedroom villa with pool and plot in Belek, Antalya
item.description: Belek, Antalya. 210 m². RealHunt score 89. This move-in ready semi-detached villa is fully furnished and ready to live in. It has 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, a living room with open kitchen and 3 balconies, plus a storage area. It sits in a complex of 8 villas with a shared pool, on a 1574 m² plot. It has air conditioners, PVC windows and shutters, and internet access. The beach is 1.5 km away, the golf course 2 km, and Antalya Airport 31 km. Asking €185,000, about €881/m².

item.title: €118,824 · Move-in ready 3-bedroom house with fireplace, terrace and garage in Dayton, Ohio
item.description: Dayton, Ohio. 128 m². RealHunt score 93. This move-in ready house has three bedrooms and one bathroom across 128 m2 of living space. The bright living room has a brick fireplace, the kitchen has white cabinetry, and the three bedrooms have fresh carpet. Outside you will find a covered front porch, a terrace, a fenced yard, a concrete patio and 4,123 sq ft of land. A detached one-car garage with an extra pad for a second vehicle, plus a full cellar with glass block windows, adds storage and parking. The home has updated HVAC with central air conditioning. Asking €118,824, about €928/m².

item.title: €76,500 · Four-bedroom house with garden and terrace in Montluçon, Allier
item.description: Montluçon, Allier. 115 m². RealHunt score 87. This is a four-bedroom house in a sought-after area of Montluçon, with 115 m2 of living space. The house includes a spacious entrance hall, a utility room, a fitted kitchen, a living room with an inset fireplace and access to the terrace, and a toilet. The upper floor has four bedrooms, a bathroom, a toilet and a large terrace. Outdoor features include a garden, a front courtyard, a garage and 1,722 sq ft of land. Asking €76,500, about €665/m².

item.title: €68,751 · House with large yard, stained glass and workshop in Conneautville, Pennsylvania
item.description: Conneautville, Pennsylvania. 140 m². RealHunt score 93. This 3-bedroom house with 1 bathroom has 140 m2 of living space on 20,042 sq ft of land in Conneautville. It features stained glass windows, woodwork, a bay window in the dining room, an enclosed front porch and hardwood floors. An attached workshop sits at the back of the house. The large yard has mature trees and room for flower or vegetable gardens, and the home sits on a low-traffic street. Asking €68,751, about €491/m².

item.title: €95,000 · Family house with konoba, outbuildings and garden in Vukšići, Zadar County, Dalmatia
item.description: Vukšići, Zadar County, Dalmatia. 120 m². RealHunt score 88. This is a family house with auxiliary buildings in a quiet part of Vukšići, near Benkovac. The main house offers about 70 m2 of living area with 2 bedrooms, a kitchen with natural light, a bathroom, a hallway and a basement. Extras include a garden, a traditional Dalmatian konoba, a storage room, a water cistern and an attic that could be converted into a flat, studio or hobby room. The house has electric heating. Good road links run to Zadar and Šibenik on the coast. Asking €95,000, about €792/m².

item.title: €95,449 · Two-bedroom house with garden and off-street parking in Wingate, County Durham
item.description: Wingate, County Durham. 91 m². RealHunt score 86. This is a two-bedroom mid terrace house in Wingate, County Durham. The accommodation has a lounge and dining room, a kitchen, two larger than average double bedrooms and a family bathroom. Outside there is a garden with landscaped areas and off-street parking on a private drive. Wingate is within reach of the A19, Teesside, Sunderland and Durham City. The living area is 91 m2. Asking €95,449, about €1,049/m².

item.title: €89,000 · Well maintained 3-bedroom house with garden and cellar in Mășloc, Timiș
item.description: Mășloc, Timiș. 165 m². RealHunt score 93. This well maintained house has 3 bedrooms, 1 bathroom and 4 rooms over 165 m2 of living space. Each room has parquet flooring and its own tiled stove, reached through a veranda-style hallway. Outside, you will find a large garden with fruit trees and grapevines, a paved courtyard, a garage, a summer kitchen with an attic and a terrace. A rustic cellar is accessed from one of the rooms. Heating is provided by a pellet boiler with radiators, and the windows are double glazed PVC. Asking €89,000, about €539/m².

item.title: €85,423 · Move-in ready 2-bedroom cottage with garage and beach access in Gansbaai, Western Cape
item.description: Gansbaai, Western Cape. 91 m². RealHunt score 86. This move-in ready cottage has two bedrooms, one bathroom and an open-plan living area. The modern kitchen has a gas stove and a breakfast nook, and there is a laundry area. Outside, there is a small front garden, a terrace, a patio and an extra-length garage, on 292 sq ft of land. A direct walkway gives access to the beach shoreline. It has pre-paid electricity and is fibre-ready. Asking €85,423, about €939/m².

item.title: €161,533 · Furnished villa with private pool and garden in Alanya, Antalya
item.description: Alanya, Antalya. 250 m². RealHunt score 90. This fully furnished villa offers 250 m2 of living space with two bedrooms and two bathrooms. It also has two separate WCs and brand-new air conditioning units. The large terrace has views from the south-west to the north, and the property includes a private pool and a secluded garden. Secure indoor parking is included, and the sea is 1.5 km away. Asking €161,533, about €646/m².

item.title: €205,486 · Move-in ready 3-bedroom villa with pool and garden in Midoun, Djerba
item.description: Midoun, Djerba. 425 m². RealHunt score 93. This move-in ready villa is fully furnished and ready to live in. It has 3 bedrooms, each with a walk-in closet, and an equipped kitchen. The garden has a barbecue area and gazebo, and there is a swimming pool, an outdoor shower and a parking space. The property has an unobstructed view and is a 6 minute walk to the beach. Reversible air conditioning is fitted, and the airport is about 30 minutes away. Asking €205,486, about €483/m².

item.title: €190,000 · 4-bedroom house with pool, garden and terrace in Essaouira, Marrakesh-Safi
item.description: Essaouira, Marrakesh-Safi. 310 m². RealHunt score 90. This house sits in a calm setting at Ounagha, near Essaouira, with 310 m2 of living space on a 1,100 m2 plot. Inside are four bedrooms, a spacious living room and a separate kitchen, plus an independent annex with its own living room, kitchen, master suite and garage. Outdoors you will find a swimming pool, a terrace, a garden, a caretaker's dwelling, and drip irrigation with 18 olive trees. Water comes from the town supply and a 35-metre well. Asking €190,000, about €613/m².

item.title: €90,139 · Move-in ready 3-bedroom house with covered terrace and garden in David, Chiriquí
item.description: David, Chiriquí. 179 m². RealHunt score 95. This move-in ready house has three bedrooms, two bathrooms and service quarters. The covered terrace runs across the back of the home and overlooks a landscaped garden with a grassy yard. The plot covers 450 square meters, or about 0.11 acres, and is fully fenced. A double carport, air conditioning and ceiling fans complete the home, which sits on a quiet residential street in David. Asking €90,139, about €504/m².

item.title: €112,500 · In good condition 4-bedroom house with garden, garages and open views in Freineda, Guarda
item.description: Freineda, Guarda. 418 m². RealHunt score 93. Detached 4-bedroom house in good condition, with 1,565.87 m² of land. The ground floor has a furnished kitchen/living room, a bedroom, a bathroom and 2 garages. The first floor has a furnished kitchen, living room, 3 bedrooms, a fireplace room, a large terrace and a balcony. Outdoor features include a garden with fruit trees, a patio with barbecue, a well and open views. Central heating runs on oil, and Vilar Formoso is 8 km away. Asking €112,500, about €269/m².

item.title: €199,500 · Villa with sea views, terraces and garage 30 m from the beach in Popenguine, Thiès Region
item.description: Popenguine, Thiès Region. 248 m². RealHunt score 88. This 248.5 m² villa stands on the second line of properties on the heights of Popenguine. It has seven bedrooms, six on the ground floor with terraces (four with private shower rooms), plus a spacious living room, open-plan kitchen and laundry room upstairs. Features include a terrace, sea views, a garage with one parking space and 5,027 sq ft of land. The beach is about 30 m away, in a very quiet neighbourhood. Asking €199,500, about €804/m².

item.title: €205,200 · 3-bedroom villa with private pool, garden and terrace in Warang, Petite Côte, Thiès
item.description: Warang, Petite Côte, Thiès. 277 m². RealHunt score 87. This single-level villa in a quiet, residential area of Warang offers 277 m² of living space. It has three bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms, an independent bedroom, a vast living room, a bright living area, a closed kitchen and a staff room. Outdoor features include a private pool, a large landscaped garden, a shaded terrace and several storage areas, on a plot of 1,911 m². The spacious plot allows for further development. Asking €205,200, about €741/m².

item.title: €140,000 · Well maintained detached house with garden and fireplace in Spodnji Ivanjci, Pomurje
item.description: Spodnji Ivanjci, Pomurje. 178 m². RealHunt score 91. This well maintained detached house, built in 1989, stands on a 1,015 m² plot in a quiet hilly setting. It offers 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a living room opening onto a glazed winter garden, and a basement cellar. Extras include a garden, a balcony, a wood-burning fireplace, a garage with carport and a cellar. It is heated by central radiators with a pellet boiler and lies about 12 km from Gornja Radgona and 8 km from the Pomurje motorway. Asking €140,000, about €787/m².

item.title: €72,000 · Fully renovated 5-bedroom house with garden and river access in Vașcău, Bihor County
item.description: Vașcău, Bihor County. 150 m². RealHunt score 94. Fully renovated house in Vașcău, with the interior renovated in 2018 and the exterior in 2024. It has five rooms, an equipped kitchen, a bathroom, a cellar, a garage and a storage shed. It has a terrace, a large garden and orchard with a gazebo, and views of the forest. The garden has direct access to the Crișul Negru River. Heating comes from a wood-fired boiler and a three-phase electric boiler, and the Vârtop ski slope and Moneasa resort are about 30 km away. Asking €72,000, about €480/m².

item.title: €60,392 · Furnished corner townhouse with pool and air conditioning in Min Buri, Bangkok
item.description: Min Buri, Bangkok. 140 m². RealHunt score 92. This is a 2-storey townhouse in a corner unit in Min Buri, Bangkok, with a usable area of 140 square metres. It has 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, plus 1 parking space. The home includes furniture, a sofa, dining table set, bed and wardrobe, and electrical appliances. Air conditioning is installed, and the project has a swimming pool and a public park nearby. It is near MRT Pink Line Talad Min Buri Station, and it faces north with an extended rear roof. Asking €60,392, about €431/m².

item.title: €65,664 · Move-in ready furnished 3-bedroom house with garden and parking in Saraphi, Chiang Mai
item.description: Saraphi, Chiang Mai. 140 m². RealHunt score 94. This move-in ready single-storey house is furnished, so it can be lived in now. It has 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a living room with a dining area and a kitchen with a counter. Outdoor features include a small garden beside the house, parking for 2 cars and land of 252 sq m. It is close to Nam Thong Market, Wachiralai School, Saraphi Hospital and Thong Floating Market, with convenient access to Chiang Mai city. Asking €65,664, about €469/m².

item.title: €235,000 · Family villa with sea views and private pool in Grand Gaube, Rivière du Rempart
item.description: Grand Gaube, Rivière du Rempart. 264 m². RealHunt score 86. This is a family villa of approximately 264 m2 in Grand Gaube. It has four air-conditioned bedrooms, four bathrooms, cupboards, a bright living room, an open-plan kitchen opening onto the dining room, a laundry room and a dressing room. The property has a private swimming pool and sea views. It is close to the beach and to local amenities, with air conditioning in every bedroom. Asking €235,000, about €890/m².

item.title: €176,874 · 3-bedroom duplex with garden, pool and sea views in Béni Khiar, Nabeul
item.description: Béni Khiar, Nabeul, Tunisia. 245 m². RealHunt score 89. This 245 m2 duplex on a 161 m2 plot sits in the second row from the sea in Béni Khiar Plage. The ground floor has a bright living room opening onto the garden and pool, plus a guest bedroom and shower room. The first floor has two master suites opening onto a terrace with sea views. Split-system air conditioning is pre-installed, central heating is available, and a garage for one car is included. Asking €176,874, about €722/m².

item.title: €143,859 · Move-in ready furnished 3-bedroom house with terrace and land in Sorá, Panamá Oeste
item.description: Sorá, Panamá Oeste. 307 m². RealHunt score 91. This move-in ready house in Sorá is fully furnished and ready to move in. It has three bedrooms and two full bathrooms, including a private bathroom in the separate third bedroom. Its covered rear terrace, laundry area and open kitchen with a work island complete the layout. The 612 m² plot has covered parking for two vehicles, fencing on three sides, flat side and rear yards, and a small covered bohío housing the water tank. It sits about 470 meters above sea level in a rural setting. Asking €143,859, about €469/m².

item.title: €89,000 · Detached house with private garden and countryside views in Torrita di Siena, Tuscany
item.description: Torrita di Siena, Tuscany. 188 m². RealHunt score 87. This detached house in Torrita di Siena offers 188 square metres of living space over two levels. The home has a spacious kitchen, a bright living room, three bedrooms and one bathroom. Outside there is a private garden of 1,500 square metres and a panoramic balcony with views of the countryside. The basement holds two large garages, a cellar, storage rooms and the heating system. It is a few steps from the historic centre, with local services close by. Asking €89,000, about €473/m².

item.title: €48,000 · 3-bedroom bungalow with garden, terrace and fireplace in Juoksenki, Lapland
item.description: Juoksenki, Lapland. 120 m². RealHunt score 91. This one-story bungalow in Juoksenki, Lapland, has about 120 m2 of living space. It has three bedrooms, a living room, a kitchen with space for a dining table, a utility room, a bathroom, a separate toilet and a private sauna. The 1085 m2 plot has a garden, a terrace and a separate storage room. An atmospheric fireplace and an air-source heat pump provide heating. The Tornionjoki River is about 150 meters away and the shop about 500 meters. Asking €48,000, about €400/m².

item.title: €151,254 · 3-bedroom villa with private garden and rooftop terrace in Ikingi Maryut, Alexandria
item.description: Ikingi Maryut, Alexandria. 210 m². RealHunt score 88. This villa offers 210 square metres of living space inside a residential compound in Ikingi Maryut, Alexandria. The home has three bedrooms and two bathrooms, giving room for family gatherings or extended stays. Outdoor features include a private garden, a balcony and a rooftop terrace with an open-air space. The compound provides security and a parking space, in a quiet, community-focused setting. Asking €151,254, about €720/m².

item.title: €94,000 · Furnished 3-bedroom house with garage and land in Roche Bois, Port Louis, Mauritius
item.description: Roche Bois, Port Louis, Mauritius. 100 m². RealHunt score 88. This furnished 3-bedroom house in Roche Bois sits on about 514 m² of land, with an interior of around 100 m². All three bedrooms and the main living hall are air-conditioned, and the open kitchen has been newly renovated. Outdoor features include a front yard, a backyard with garden areas, trees and plants, a garage and a spacious rear terrace. Riche Terre Mall is about 2 minutes away by car, Terre Rouge about 5 minutes and Port Louis about 10 minutes. Asking €94,000, about €940/m².
